 """A U-Net-style skip/concat source; transposed convolution is opaque."""

 def __init__(self):
 super().__init__()
 self.stem = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
 self.refinement = nn.ModuleList([ConvRefinement(8) for _ in range(2)])
 self.downsample = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
 self.bottleneck = nn.Conv2d(8, 16, 3, padding=1)
 self.upsample = nn.ConvTranspose2d(16, 8, 2, stride=2)
 self.head = nn.Conv2d(16, 2, 1)

 def forward(self, image):
 skip = self.stem(image)
 for block in self.refinement:
 skip = block(skip)
 coarse = self.bottleneck(self.downsample(skip))
 restored = self.upsample(coarse)
 merged = torch.cat((skip, restored), dim=1)
 return self.head(merged)"}},{"id":"call:instance:model.SkipSegmentation.stem","sourceLabel":"stem","kind":"Conv2d","category":"convolution","evidence":"contract","instanceId":"instance:model.SkipSegmentation.stem","callCount":1,"callId":"call:instance:model.SkipSegmentation.stem","source":{"path":"model.py","line":49,"endLine":49,"expression":"self.stem(image)"}},{"id":"repeat:instance:model.SkipSegmentation.refinement","sourceLabel":"refinement","kind":"Repeat","category":"container","evidence":"source","repeat":{"count":2,"sharing":"independent"},"source":{"path":"model.py","line":50,"endLine":51,"expression":"for block in self.refinement:
